 Black Friday 2026: Early deals from Kate Spade, Dyson, Hoka and more, plus everything we know so far about the big sale
 There's no time like the 'present' to score early Black Friday deals on holiday gifts, home essentials, wardrobe staples and tech gear. 
 Britt Ross Follow Senior Writer, Deals Updated Thu, November 12, 2026 at 3:52 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Updated Thu, November 12, 2026 at 3:52 PM UTC Our experts independently review everything we recommend. If you buy through our links, we may earn commission.
 Make your list and check it twice — early Black Friday deals are here! (Getty Images) I realize you've probably yet to order your Thanksgiving turkey, but here's the deal: We're officially in holiday shopping season, as evidenced by the smattering of early Black Friday sales popping up as we speak. As professional shoppers with years of experience covering savings events, we're advocates of hunting down Black Friday deals well before Black Friday proper — after all, the early bird gets the worm, and by worm, we mean the giftable goodies that often sell out. That's why we've gone ahead and cherry-picked the best Black Friday discounts you can score as we speak.
 Trending early Black Friday deals 
 Kate Spade Lucy Wristlet ($35, was $139): 75% off
 Ring Battery Doorbell 2K (newest model) ($40, was $100): 60% off 
 Dyson V8 Cordless Vacuum & Car Kit ($300, was $450): $150 off 
 Ugg Tazzette Genuine Shearling Collar Slipper ($70, was $110): $40 off 
 Shark AI Self-Emptying Robot Vacuum ($290, was $432): $142 off 
 When is Black Friday 2026?
 Black Friday is always the day after Thanksgiving, and this year, it falls on Friday, Nov. 27. That said, many retailers kick off their Black Friday sales earlier, which is why this month is often referred to as "Black November." Yes, this means you'll be bombarded with holiday sale messaging long before your turkey has even defrosted, but the good news is, you'll be able to get a head start on your gift shopping ahead of the Black Friday hubbub.
 What is the difference between Black Friday and Cyber Monday?
 Black Friday sales usually continue through the holiday weekend and into Cyber Monday, which is on Monday, Nov. 30. While the two savings events have merged into one long weekend of markdowns for the most part, Black Friday sales often involve a mix of in-store and online discounts, whereas Cyber Monday has historically been a web-focused sale extravaganza.
 Advertisement Advertisement Deals will vary from retailer to retailer, so just because you see something on sale during Black Friday, don't assume it'll still be discounted for Cyber Monday. When in doubt, add to cart and check out!
 What to buy during Black Friday
 During sales like Prime Day , we usually advise readers to hold off on purchasing items in the tech and large appliance categories — and that's because it's worth waiting until Black Friday. If you've wanted to upgrade your TV or get a new dishwasher, this is the time to do it!
 To be honest, there's not much we wouldn't recommend buying during Black Friday; most major retailers will be offering some of their deepest discounts of the year on everything from kitchen essentials to beauty favorites, and it's also a stellar time to stock up on clothing. Of course, many of us will be shopping for gifts, so if you see something on your list for a great price, grab it before it sells out.
 The only things you should steer clear of? Bad deals. Not all Black Friday sales are created equal, so it's important to pick out the legit markdowns from the duds. Retailers can sneakily raise starting prices to make a discount seem more impressive than it is, and it's always a good idea to compare sales across the web to make sure you're getting the best price.
 Advertisement Advertisement Actually, that's our job; our team of deals experts has been tracking the best early Black Friday deals for you to peruse before the cost-cutting chaos ensues. Keep checking back, as we'll be updating our picks throughout the month — happy saving!
